claims.claim_text: The indexed Sergeant Alexander W. Baird is confirmed in the official Army enlistment table.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact name and private identifier agree across the OSS index and official Army record; the Army record's entry grade is compatible with the later indexed Sergeant rank.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact full name and exact unique private-identifier agreement across two official NARA records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army table documents entry from civil life on February 16, 1943; the OSS index supplies no service date, so the Army-to-OSS sequence still requires the personnel file.
claims.match_notes: The private identifier is never quoted publicly. Common-name death and directory candidates without that identifier were rejected.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry in February 1943, Alexander W. Baird's record carried the civilian occupation category commercial artists.
